description: External validation collection of intentionally vulnerable Terraform scenarios covering IAM privilege escalation, public S3 storage, exposed databases, insecure security groups, and missing encryption.

cases.description: Publicly accessible S3 bucket configuration with ACL set to public-read
Unrestricted ingress SSH access from 0.0.0.0/0 on port 22
IAM role with overly permissive administrator wildcard permissions
Unencrypted RDS instance lacking KMS customer managed key encryption
